notes: Pick faces that refill themselves: every picked SKU gets a min/max rule sized nightly from its own demand. Pick from another location at a stop, or per line on the order. Safer under real conditions: cycle counts never undo picks made after the count, cancelled picks wait for a confirmed put-back, card-paid orders can't ship unpaid, offline scanning is off by default and never sent as the wrong person, and deleting a portal group never opens up what its people may do.
